purpose: Development set for retrieval over Nigerian federal legislation in English (RSV-12): every route on the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023, to compare ranking profiles while building. Not a held-out set.
corpus: The Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023 (ng-data-protection-act-2023) as published; judgments name provisions by their locators in the reviewed text
limitations: Judged by the author of the retrieval code from the Act's text; no qualified reviewer has checked the judgments (EVAL-04), so scores support no quality claim.
One Act; scores say nothing about other laws, languages or jurisdictions.
Definitions are judged at their reviewed locators (sec_65__def_…); a text whose interpretation section is not yet structured scores lower on definition cases.
